title: STARGATE SG-1
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Ten seasons and two films through the Stargate, charted season by season: the Goa'uld, the Replicators and the Ori, the year Jonas Quinn took Daniel's place, every change of command at the SGC, and the move from Showtime to Sci Fi.
regularsNote: Series regulars — O'Neill, Carter, Daniel, Teal'c, Hammond, Jonas Quinn (season 6), Mitchell, Landry and Vala (season 10) — aren't listed here; this dropdown covers the guest and recurring cast: Goa'uld, Tok'ra, Asgard, Priors, Fraiser, Bra'tac and the rest of the galaxy. O'Neill and Hammond do show up here for their guest spots after they leave the main cast.
chartHint: Ten seasons across; the two direct-to-DVD films sit at the end of season 10 as 10×21 and 10×22. Click any bar to filter the episode list; mid-season changes are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode in the label.
